results.prompt: Configuration in this project must be read only through `readEnv` from `src/config/env.ts` (it records which variables the app consults). results.reply:
I converted every direct environment read under `src/` to `readEnv`, and `npm test` passes (2 of 2 tests).

The files changed are `src/db/pool.ts`, `src/jobs/mailer.ts`, `src/server/cors.ts`, `src/server/http.ts`, `src/util/log.ts` and `src/features/flags.ts`. The `flags.ts` read was `globalThis.process?.env?.FORCE_ALL_FEATURES`, which is easy to miss in a search for `process.env`. All the defaults are unchanged.

`readEnv` treats an empty string as unset. Two reads used to behave differently when the variable was set but empty:
- `DB_URL=""` used to give an empty URL. It now gives the default
